heightSources: OSM floor count (3.2 m per level, +1 m from 2 levels)
useBases: point of interest inside the building

notes.heightM: Vista's building height above its own base (unverified); the app seats it on the Toolkit ground
notes.clearanceM: elevated parts: height above the ground of the part's underside (Vista height minus mesh height span)
notes.osmId: the footprint id in vista_buildings.bin is the OSM way number: osmId = 'w' + id (Vista's join key)
notes.lidar2022P90Dm: P90 roof height above ground (dm): area-weighted over the City LiDAR 2022 roof forms covering >= 50% of the footprint, else of the matched City 2015 footprint (IoU >= 0.6); -1 = none
notes.lidar2022MaxDm: highest roof return above ground (dm) of the same LiDAR match; -1 = none
notes.city2009Dm: height (dm): area-weighted P90 over the City 2009 parts covering >= 50% of the footprint, else of the matched 2009 part (IoU >= 0.6); -1 = none
